title: Broadcom Inc. (AVGO)’s AI Opportunity Expands Across AI Infrastructure
excerpt: The AI infrastructure market is in a powerful expansion phase, with hyperscalers making significant investments in custom AI accelerators, high-speed network...
content_html:
The AI infrastructure market is in a powerful expansion phase, with hyperscalers making significant investments in custom AI accelerators, high-speed networking, as well as complex data-center architectures. Even though Nvidia is the dominant GPU supplier, Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) happens to be a key beneficiary of the transition towards customized AI infrastructure.

In its latest results, Q3 2026 revenue rose 86% YoY to $29.6 billion, with AI semiconductor revenue up 221% to $16.7 billion. The firm expects AI semiconductor revenue to rise further to $21.7 billion in Q4 2026, up 236% YoY. Notably, total Q4 revenue is expected at ~$34.8 billion, up by 93%.

AI isn't just increasing revenue, but it is also generating significant cash flow. Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) managed $13.7 billion of FCF in Q3 2026, which equates to 46% of its revenue. As a result, the company has ample financial flexibility amidst investments in AI opportunities.

Custom Silicon Should Result in Upside Opportunity

The biggest upside opportunity revolves around Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO)'s custom AI accelerator business. The hyperscalers need chips tailored to certain workloads. Custom silicon can deliver better performance, power efficiency, and economics at massive scale.

Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO)'s advantage stems from combining custom accelerator design with high-speed networking. As AI clusters grow, customers need more than compute; they also need faster connectivity between thousands of processors. Therefore, there will be a powerful infrastructure flywheel, i.e., more AI compute resulting in greater networking requirements, which will in turn result in more Broadcom content per AI cluster.

Management noted that the opportunity might go well beyond FY 2026. The company anticipates ~$115 billion of AI semiconductor revenue in FY 2027 and $230 billion in FY2028. This means that the current AI ramp can demonstrate a multiyear growth cycle.

Broadcom Has an Edge Over Custom-Silicon Rivals

Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRVL) remains a key competitor in custom AI silicon as well as networking. That being said, Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) has been operating at a much larger scale. It reported $16.7 billion in Q3 AI semiconductor revenue. Furthermore, the combination of custom accelerators as well as networking gives exposure to AI infrastructure rather than being dependent on the single chip program.

Hedge Funds and Short Interest

Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) enjoys a more favorable short-interest profile compared to Marvell. Short interest is ~1.20% of AVGO's float, compared with 3.79% for MRVL. This means there remains a significantly lower bearish positioning in Broadcom.
